tex_content.label: lncurvgrowth
tex_content.html:
For $t'\le t''$, \[ L(t'')\le L(t')e^{C_2(t''-t')}, \qquad \Theta (t'')+L(t'')\le (\Theta (t')+L(t'))e^{(C_1+C_2)(t''-t')}. \] In particular, $\Theta (t'')\le (\Theta (t')+L(t'))e^{(C_1+C_2)(t''-t')}$.
Proof

↗ lem:curve-shrinking-length-curvature-growth \sketch Apply Gronwall first to $L$ and then to $L+\Theta $.

□

For $t'\le t''$,
\[
L(t'')\le L(t')e^{C_2(t''-t')},
\qquad
\Theta(t'')+L(t'')\le(\Theta(t')+L(t'))e^{(C_1+C_2)(t''-t')}.
\]
In particular,
$\Theta(t'')\le(\Theta(t')+L(t'))e^{(C_1+C_2)(t''-t')}$.
\end{corollary}
